ns2:section.sectionText: Narratives of Empire. Description: Examines literary devices and narrative techniques in Filipino, Pacific Islander, Puerto Rican, and Cuban American cultural texts. We will investigate how narratives of US empire, colonialism, and immigration negotiate, contest, and complicate the assumed conventions of coming of age novels. This is an intensive writing course that will train students how to critically analyze culture and write sophisticated essays. Meets with LLS 390, CRN 51339, section B.
